text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While walking along the river bank, I hear some lively voices coming from behind me.

text_block_list.name: Five Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Rock, paper, scissors, shoot!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Everyone threw out rock—except for El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Impossible! Grrr… When we reach the next streetlight, victory is mine!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Okay, hand over the baggage, King! It's my turn to carry it. Vamos!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Phew… I'm finally free of that burden! Careful, El. With this game, if you lose even once—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: And so, King escapes the loop of endless losses in bag-carrying rock, paper, scissors. Unfortunately, however, at the next streetlight…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Stop right there! I'll thank you not to make such ominous statements!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But after we get all this stuff back to the dorm, we're going to have a carrot party together!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm so glad the weather's nice today. There's nothing like enjoying carrot sticks out in the fresh air! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But you know, now that I think about it, Spe and Grass are the only ones who haven't lost a game yet, right?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh… Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe… In that case, how about we settle things in the next match, Spe?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wha?! H-hang on, Grass!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Rrraaaghhh!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Argh, the four of you are mucho slow! I'm already at the next light!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh my. Well then, Spe, I'll be going on ahead as well…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Grass?! Wait, you're too fast!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: So, Sky… I presume that was a deliberate attempt to motivate Grass back there, yes?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm? I dunno what you mean… I just noticed that some people hadn't had a turn carrying the bags yet. That's all, honest.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: And besides, no matter which one of those two wins the next match, and the match after that, we won't have to worry about carrying those bags again.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmph… So that's your strategy?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: No, no, I just have faith in them is all. They're such good girls, you know?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sigh… You really are something else, Sky.
